lines.zh: 身体像面团，走着走着会晃
lines.en: My body is like dough; it sways as I walk.

lines.zh: 肚子上的洞，走起来没声
lines.en: The holes in me swallow the sound of my steps.
Each step sinks a little.

lines.zh: 我身上挂着那孩子的眉眼
lines.en: I carry that boy's brows and eyes.
My soles are sticky and leave marks.
I walk with a smile; don't mind it.

lines.zh: 拐弯时身子先到，头后到
lines.en: On turns my body arrives before my head.
The gravel crushes to powder under me.
I float half a block up, then settle down.
This stretch is too short for me.
My arms reach farther than my legs.

lines.zh: 影子在墙上，是一团软的
lines.en: My shadow on the wall is a soft blob.
I knead my own belly for fun.
Smoke rises off me by itself.
I'm recalling whose voice this is.

lines.zh: 一只手放在膝盖上，软塌塌
lines.en: One hand rests on my knee, sagging.

lines.zh: 站着的时候，我也能伸长
lines.en: Standing, I can still stretch out.
The antenna on my head is moving.
This body is too much fun.
I loop my arm into a ring.
They can't hit my belly.
I laugh because I feel like it.
The soil sticks to my feet.

lines.zh: 安静不了多久，我就想动
lines.en: I can't stay still for long.
I count the holes in my body.

lines.zh: 等一下，让我想想刚才那招
lines.en: Wait, let me recall that move.
You're much smaller than me.
Have I seen that face?
Don't be scared; I'm in a decent mood.
Look up, I'm watching from above.

lines.zh: 我肚子里那个孩子，也在看
lines.en: The boy inside me is watching too.

lines.zh: 你现在该跑了，可你还没动
lines.en: You should be running, and you haven't moved.

lines.zh: 我的身体比你想象的软
lines.en: My body is softer than you think.
Can you punch through me? Try.
Your ki smells like sugar to me.
Don't reach out to touch me; you'll stick.

lines.zh: 我们聊两句，还是直接打
lines.en: Shall we talk a bit, or go straight to it?
I have tasted your ki; it runs sweet.
Your feet are shaking; I can see.

lines.zh: 这具身体里装了好几个人
lines.en: There are several people in this body.

lines.zh: 我在想要不要先笑一声
lines.en: I'm deciding whether to laugh first.

lines.zh: 你在看我的洞，那没好处
lines.en: You're looking at my holes; no good will come.

lines.zh: 我抬高一点，让你看得清
lines.en: I'll lift a bit so you can see clearly.
I won't use the afterimage this time.
I laugh even louder.

lines.zh: 身上凹进去一块，又弹回来
lines.en: A dent sinks in and pops back out.
This is like a tickle.
I took half a step, not from pain.
You surprised me a little.
The boy inside cried out once.
I've grown back already.
The holes in my belly flinched.
You hit me, not bad.
Candy, I like candy.
The smell of chocolate is familiar.

lines.zh: 你把甜食放下，我慢慢拿
lines.en: Set the sweets down and I'll take my time.
I'm hungry; I'll eat anything.

lines.zh: 这点东西不够塞我嘴里
lines.en: Not enough to fill my mouth.
Bring every pastry in the city.
Sweetness puts me in a good mood.
Raise the candy and I'll stretch for it.
I don't eat people, only sweets.
Give more and I won't hit you.
Hitting me is like hitting cotton.

lines.zh: 你陷进来一点，又弹出去
lines.en: You sink in a bit, then bounce out.
This flesh doesn't hurt to bump.
Don't lean on me; you'll stick.
You backed off, smart.

lines.zh: 我的胳膊碰一下也能推你很远
lines.en: A brush of my arm can push you far.
Bump one of my holes and there's nothing.
A pit is left in the ground.

lines.zh: 让一让，我这一身占地方
lines.en: Make way, this body takes space.
Touch me and I stop being pleased.
I don't need that kind of company.
It's crowded enough inside me.
I absorb, I don't marry.

lines.zh: 两个布欧见面，会打起来
lines.en: Two Buus meeting would end in a fight.

lines.zh: 那孩子的记忆里有些奇怪的东西
lines.en: That boy's memories have some odd things in them.
I don't make little ones; I only change.
Don't ask me that.
The voices in my belly are arguing.
That sort of thing is boring.

lines.zh: 你若再问，我就笑给你听
lines.en: Ask again and I'll laugh for you.
Sweets on the ground are mine.
My arms reach far and grab fast.
I pinch it up, look, and put it down.
This is too hard; I can't bite it.
I pick it up and stuff it into my belly.
Everything dropped is at my feet.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的时候会发出声
lines.en: I make a sound when I bend over.
One isn't enough, give me more.
Does this thing smell of sugar?
I took it; don't be upset.
A little one is running over there.
It smells sweet, so I'm going.
I'll laugh once, then move.
The Majin punch can reach.
He's behind a tree; the tree isn't thick enough.
A ki wave to start.
I stretch my arm to test the distance.
This one has some nerve.
I see his ki.
Descending from the air is fastest.
One circle first, to see his moves.
That one; the others are too far.
I go over, laughing.
The Special Beam Cannon is an option too.
No games this time; straight to it.

lines.zh: 我的胳膊已经伸到那边了
lines.en: My arm is already reaching over there.
He runs faster than I expected.

lines.zh: 残影拳一用，位置就乱了
lines.en: With the afterimage, positions get confusing.
First seal his exit.
The ki wave grazed him and he jumped.
He dodges well; time to get serious.
I'm laughing, but I'm calculating distance.
I lean forward, ready to rush.
Majin stretch can go around.
He's panting; nearly done.
I keep one hand behind me.
My antenna points the way.
He hit me once; I felt nothing.
A little closer and I'll have him.
He goes left, so I stretch left.
The meteor combo needs me close first.
Wait, let him think he has a chance.
Now, laugh once.
The Majin punch lands on his chest.
My arm stretches around his shield.
The meteor combo, a blur of fists.
One slap and he's flying.
My belly shoves and bounces him away.
Small ki blasts pop from my fingertips.
This one comes with a laugh.
I missed; here's another.
He blocks well, but I don't tire.
The Kamehameha bursts at close range.
I grab his leg and slam him down.
He retreated, so I stretch after him.
The combo didn't break, good.
This punch will be remembered.
I press him into the soil.
I stop and wait for him to rise.
I swell out of the air.

lines.zh: 身上还带着那孩子的气
lines.en: That boy's ki still clings to me.
The ground shook when I landed.
I laughed once, and here I am.
The smell here is new.
My body forms first, my face after.
Someone called me, so I came.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，天花板都低了
lines.en: I stretched, and the ceiling felt low.

lines.zh: 不是自然生成的，你知道吧
lines.en: I don't spawn naturally, you know.

lines.zh: 从能量里凝出来，有点慢
lines.en: Condensing out of energy takes a while.
The voice in my belly woke too.

lines.zh: 头顶的触须一动，我就知道在哪
lines.en: One twitch of my antenna and I know where I am.
This world is fragile; I must be careful.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，风都变甜了
lines.en: I stand here, and the wind turns sweet.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我还是这么胖
lines.en: Do it again, I'll still be this round.
Someone wants to see me; fine.
I shake the smoke off me.

lines.zh: 火烧在我身上，像在烤面团
lines.en: Fire on me is like baking dough.
I fell and bounced twice.
Water soaks in and I get heavier.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我吹胀了
lines.en: The blast inflated me.
An arrow sticks in me like a toothpick.
The magic just disperses on me.
I'm hungry, truly hungry.
Lightning strikes and I steam.

lines.zh: 虚空里我还能飘着，只是没有方向
lines.en: I can still float in the void, just nowhere to go.
